text:
```yaml
name: ADR Agent Review

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  adr-agent:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install Copilot CLI
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://github.com/github/copilot-cli/releases/latest/download/copilot-linux -o /usr/local/bin/copilot
          chmod +x /usr/local/bin/copilot

      - name: Run ADR Generator Agent
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # The agent persona file is used as a prompt for the Copilot CLI
          copilot generate \
            --prompt-file .github/agents/adr-generator.agent.md \
            --output docs/adr/ADR-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S).md
          # Commit the generated ADR if it exists
          if [ -s docs/adr/ADR-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S).md ]; then
            git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
            git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
            git add docs/adr/ADR-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S).md
            git commit -m "Add ADR generated by Copilot agent"
            git push
          else
            echo "No ADR was generated."
          fi
```
